transcript.text: Hello! How can I assist you today?
I need to cancel my Department of Labor appointment.

To prevent fraudulent cancellation, I can't cancel your appointment directly. However, I can help you get in touch with a representative who can assist you. If you have your confirmation number, I can look up your appointment details and transfer you to an agent. Would you like to provide that number?
I couldn't find an appointment with the confirmation number 482913. Could you please double-check the number and provide it again?
